current_page_main_arc: Page 7 presents the core findings on ChatGPT's explanation quality through Figure 3, establishing two key metrics: answer-explanation concordance and Density of Insight (DOI). The page transitions from accuracy analysis (covered on page 6) to evaluating whether AI-generated explanations contain educationally valuable insights. The main narrative establishes that 88.9% of ChatGPT responses contained at least one significant insight, and that high-quality outputs are characterized by DOI>0.6, with accurate answers showing significantly higher DOI than inaccurate ones.

continuity_resolutions.to_page_8: Page 7 ends mid-sentence discussing DOI thresholds (DOI>0.6 for high quality outputs). Page 8 then transitions into the Discussion section, so page 7 represents the final results presentation before interpretation begins.
